acip: ,NANG GI SGRIB PA CAN NI KHA KHAB KYI MIG TZAM LA ME 'BAR BA DANG , MGRIN PA JENG GI RGYUD TZAM LA GSUS PO CHE DAG STE, GEGS BYED PA MED CING ZAS SKOM RNYED DU ZIN KYANG BZA' BTUNG BYED MI NUS PA'O,
wylie: nang gi sgrib pa can ni kha khab kyi mig tsam la me 'bar ba dang , mgrin pa jeng gi rgyud tsam la gsus po che dag ste, gegs byed pa med cing zas skom rnyed du zin kyang bza' btung byed mi nus pa'o
english: Those craving spirits with inner obstacles have mouths no bigger than the eye of a needle, spouting with flame. Their throats are the size of a guitar string, but their bellies are huge. Even where there is no one to stop them, and even when they can locate something to eat or drink, they find themselves unable to get it down.
